queries.query: "LLM" OR "large language model" AND "network configuration" OR "network config" generation
queries.rationale: Direct search for papers and demos where LLMs produce network configurations or translate operator intent into device configs (core phenomenon for NetOps workflows).

queries.query: "intent-based networking" AND ("LLM" OR "language model" OR "natural language")
queries.rationale: Connects classical IBN work with modern LLM-driven intent→configuration pipelines and identifies prior intent-parsing architectures and their limitations.

queries.query: "generate-validate-repair" OR "generate-then-verify" OR "verify-and-repair" AND (network OR configuration) AND (LLM OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Locate architectures that combine generation with external validators or iterative repair loops—central to mitigation strategies and reliability engineering.

queries.query: formal verification network configuration OR "network verification" (VeriFlow OR NetKAT OR HSA) AND (LLM OR "natural language")
queries.rationale: Survey formal/deterministic validators used in NetOps (and their applicability as validators for LLM outputs).

queries.query: "hallucination" AND (LLM OR "large language model") AND (network OR NetOps OR configuration)
queries.rationale: Identify documented failure modes (hallucinations, inventing commands/semantics) specific to network tasks and safety-critical impact analyses.

queries.query: "tool-augmented" OR "tool use" OR "toolformer" OR "RAG" (retrieval-augmented OR external-tool) AND (network OR configuration)
queries.rationale: Find work on augmenting LLMs with retrieval, external state, or domain tools to ground outputs—key mitigation mechanism for correctness/traceability.

queries.query: benchmarks OR "benchmark" AND (NetOps OR "network configuration" OR AIOps OR "network change") AND (validity OR "construct validity" OR "evaluation methodology")
queries.rationale: Collect benchmark papers and critiques to assess construct and external validity of existing NetOps/AIOps evaluation suites (TSNBench, 6G-Bench, OpsEval, etc.).

queries.query: "emulator" OR "mininet" OR "ns-3" OR "container lab" OR "testbed" AND (evaluation OR validation) AND (LLM OR automation OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Identify evaluation platforms and methods for executing or simulating configuration changes and measuring operational correctness and side effects.

queries.query: "operator trust" OR "human-in-the-loop" OR "human-AI collaboration" AND (NetOps OR network operation OR configuration)
queries.rationale: Review studies on human oversight, acceptance, and workflows for AI-assisted network management—relevant to mitigation, trust, and deployment practices.

queries.query: "adversarial" OR "attack" OR "safety" AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (network OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Search for adversarial or safety analyses that target LLM-driven operational agents or attempt to induce unsafe NetOps actions (security of agentic workflows).

queries.query: "orchestration" OR "agentic" OR "autonomous agent" AND (NetOps OR network management) AND (LLM OR policy)
queries.rationale: Survey agentic or orchestration frameworks that coordinate LLMs, tools, and validators for autonomous NetOps tasks (system-level mechanisms and failures).

queries.query: datasets OR corpora AND ("network configurations" OR "router configs" OR "switch configs" OR "device configs") AND (dataset OR corpus OR benchmark)
queries.rationale: Find available datasets for training/evaluating LLMs on NetOps tasks and assess coverage, licensing, and representativeness (data sources for experiments).

queries.query: explainability OR "model interpretability" AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (network OR NetOps OR configuration)
queries.rationale: Locate methods for making LLM outputs understandable to operators (justifications, provenance, traceability)—important for mitigations and operator trust.

queries.query: "change control" OR "auditing" OR "compliance" AND (network OR NetOps) AND (automation OR AI OR LLM)
queries.rationale: Capture literature on governance, audit trails, and compliance for automated configuration changes—operational mitigations and legal/organizational constraints.

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed conference or journal papers; arXiv/preprint manuscripts with verifiable metadata and versions; tool/project pages or code repositories with released artifacts and stable identifiers; benchmark/dataset descriptions with methodology and access instructions; RFCs, standards, and vendor technical advisories where relevant; empirical evaluations, simulation/testbed studies, and formal-methods work applicable to NetOps; papers that address LLM failure modes, mitigation architectures (generate-verify-repair, RAG, tool use), or human-AI NetOps workflows.
exclusion_criteria: Undated, unverifiable blog posts or ephemeral social-media claims (except vendor advisories with stable references); opinion pieces without methods or evidence; duplicated versions of the same work without primary-source citation (cite primary version); purely NLP/LLM papers with no discussed applicability to network operations or configuration-related tasks (unless they introduce mitigation mechanisms transferrable to NetOps); paywalled sources that cannot be verified for bibliographic metadata (title/authors/venue/year).
date_rationale: Prioritize literature from 2016–2026 to cover the modern programmable-network and LLM era (transformer era begins ~2017–2018) while explicitly including foundational older work for formal verification, intent-based networking, and configuration management where historically relevant.
